description: A crumbling brick/stone wall segment with a crenellated top, a collapsed gap at the base and an eroded corner -- a leftover fortification, not a full building. 18x10px.
grid: F F  F  F  F  F  F
notes: Crenellation motif directly from 304820/2390773 castle saves (alternating solid/gap merlons along the top edge). Erosion holes are hand-placed here rather than via the generic pass so the 'ruined' read is guaranteed even before the per-instance erosion roll runs.
